summary: 2P 2U HPE ProLiant DL380 Gen11 rack server. Starter extract from the HPE QuickSpecs, including a partial processor table.

processors.note: The option list is a partial extract of the QuickSpecs processor table, not the full orderable list. 5th Generation processors require a system board shipped for that generation. Field upgrade from 4th Generation to 5th Generation is not supported.

value.populationNote: 32 DIMMs only with 8SFF or 16SFF; 16 DIMMs maximum with 24SFF. Maximum memory speed is limited by the processor.

chassis: 8SFF (SAS/SATA/NVMe) with optional Universal Media Bay and up to 6 SFF rear
24SFF with up to 6 SFF rear for a total of 30 SFF
8LFF supporting 2 SFF front and up to 4 LFF rear or 2 SFF rear
12LFF with optional 4 LFF rear for a total of 16 LFF
12EDSFF (NVMe) supporting up to 36 EDSFF in front and up to 2 SFF rear

maximumInternalStorage.configuration: 12+4+4x 18 TB (with optional rear LFF drive cage)
12+4+4 x 18 TB (with optional rear LFF drive cage)

maximumInternalStorage.drive: Hot Plug SFF NVMe PCIe SSD

storage.note: Maximum internal storage rows are configuration-dependent QuickSpecs figures, stored as extracted. They are not the capacity of every chassis.

networking.note: The starter extract does not include the QuickSpecs networking option table.

power.note: PSU wattage and system planning watts were not extracted. Use HPE Power Advisor for a configuration-specific figure.

support.note: End-of-support dates were not retrieved from an HPE lifecycle page.

firmwareBaseline.reason: No firmware, BIOS, or driver version is included in the starter dataset. Import an HPE firmware repository or a file you obtained yourself. Versions are never synthesized.
